catalogClauses.base: Caster throws a legendary Spear with deadly precision through the entire arena, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. When the skewered hero hits the arena wall, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
catalogClauses.super: Super: Impales up to 2 units and leaves a fire trail behind for 10 seconds. Deals 35 damage per second and slows by 20%. Debuff lingers for 2 seconds. Increases damage by 100 and stun duration by 1s.
catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: Spear range increased by 1600, and bounces off the arena wall 2 times. Skewered units are pinned at the wall before the bounce.
